command:
printf 'R109_UNAME='; uname -r; printf 'R109_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'R109_TAINT='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted; printf 'R109_DTB_SHA='; if test -r /sys/firmware/fdt; then sha256sum /sys/firmware/fdt; else printf 'UNAVAILABLE
'; fi; printf 'R109_MODEL='; if test -r /proc/device-tree/model; then tr '\000' '
' < /proc/device-tree/model; else printf 'UNAVAILABLE
'; fi; printf 'R109_IDMA_NODES
'; ls -l /dev/idma* 2>/dev/null; printf 'R109_MEMINFO
'; head -n 3 /proc/meminfo; printf 'R109_READONLY_IDENTITY_END
'
limits: TTY open/configuration can affect host modem state; no explicit DTR/RTS control. Only a framed software identity query; no proof of live BIT hash, mode, or physical clock.
